name: 灯織
text: 『事務所までもう少しかかります』
trans: "Will take a while longer before I arrive at the office."

name: 灯織
text: 『プロデューサーこそ、朝早くからお疲れ様です』
trans:
"Thank you to you too for starting work so early,
Producer."

name: 円香
text:
……側溝に落ちるところだったね
拾ってくれて助かった
trans:
...I dropped it near the gutter, I see.
Thanks for picking it up for me.

name: 灯織
trans: No problem. Glad we didn't lose it.

name: 円香
text:
うしろにいたんだ
気付かなかった
trans:
You were behind me, huh.
I didn't notice...

name: 灯織
text:
あ……私も……
すみません、樋口さんだって気付かなくて
trans:
Ah... That makes the two of us...
Sorry, I didn't realize that it was you, Higuchi-san.

name: 円香
text: ……拾ってくれたこれ、知ってる？
trans: ......Do you know of the item you picked up?

name: 灯織
trans:
......?
It's a lip moisturizer, isn't it......?

name: 円香
text: ……これ、駅の近くにしか売ってないんだけど、おすすめ
trans:
......This moisturizer, it's only available at a shop near
the station but I really recommend it.

name: 円香
text: 香りもないし、結構使いやすい
trans: It's unscented, and pretty easy to use.

name: 円香
text: 肌に合う合わないはあると思うけど
trans: Though that will really depend if it suits your skin.

name: 灯織
text:
……ありがとうございます
覚えておきます
trans:
......Thank you for the recommendation.
I'll remember it.

name: 灯織
text: 行き先は事務所ですか？
trans: Are you heading to the office?

name: 灯織
text: ……樋口さんも朝早くからお疲れ様です
trans:
......Must be tough on Higuchi-san too for starting
work so early in the morning.

name: 円香
text:
あ、全然……
置き忘れた本を取りに行くだけ
trans:
Ah, not at all......
I'm just heading over to pick up a book I forgot there.

name: 灯織
text:
あっ、そうでしたか
すみません……
trans:
Ah, I see now.
Sorry I misunderstood......

name: 円香
text: 今日の昼が図書館の返却期限で
trans:
Well, it's a library book due this afternoon so I had to
come.

name: 円香
trans: Have a job coming up, Kazano-san?

name: 円香
trans: ......Seems like it's really busy on your end.

name: 灯織
text:
あの、もし支障なければ……なんですけど
樋口さんって何座ですか……？
trans:
Erm, If......you don't mind me asking,
what's your constellation, Higuchi-san?

name: 円香
trans:
Huh......?
Ahh, you mean my zodiac sign......?
